vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something easier for someone
vocabulary.example: Can you help me carry this box?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to forgive; used in "Excuse me" to get attention politely
vocabulary.example: Excuse me, is this seat free?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send a short message by phone

vocabulary.example: I got your message this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the paper that shows how much you pay in a restaurant

quiet and relaxed, not angry or worried
having lived for a number of years

fine_lines.title: Take care vs Take it easy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Take care تُقال عند الوداع وتعني: اعتنِ بنفسك. أما Take it easy فتعني: لا تقلق، خذ الأمور ببساطة، وتُقال لشخص متوتر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Take care" is a goodbye: look after yourself. "Take it easy" means relax, don't worry, often to someone stressed.

examples.sentence: Bye, see you tomorrow. Take care!
Take it easy, the exam is not hard.

fine_lines.title: check vs bill
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى فاتورة المطعم. check تُستخدم في أمريكا، وbill في بريطانيا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the paper you pay in a restaurant. "Check" is American English, "bill" is British English.

examples.sentence: Can we have the check, please?
Could I have the bill, please?

fine_lines.title: I think so vs I don't think so
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I think so = أظن ذلك (نعم غالبًا). I don't think so = لا أظن ذلك (لا غالبًا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I think so" is a soft yes. "I don't think so" is a soft no.

examples.sentence: Is the shop open? - I think so.
Is it going to rain? - I don't think so.

expressions.meaning_en: A strong way to say thanks.
expressions.example: Thank you so much for the lovely gift.

expressions.meaning_ar: أنا ممتن لك حقًا / يعطيك العافية.
expressions.meaning_en: A warm, strong way to show thanks.
expressions.example: You fixed my laptop? I really appreciate it.

expressions.meaning_en: Many thanks (informal).
expressions.example: Thanks a lot for the ride.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite request for help.
expressions.example: Can you help me, please? I can't find the station.

expressions.meaning_en: Used to get attention or to pass someone politely.
expressions.example: Excuse me, can I get past?

expressions.meaning_en: Used to encourage someone or to hurry them.
expressions.example: Come on, it will be fun!

expressions.meaning_en: You did not get the meaning.
expressions.example: Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say it again?

expressions.meaning_en: Informal: I don't understand.
expressions.example: I read the question twice, but I don't get it.

expressions.meaning_en: I will send you a phone message.
expressions.example: I'll text you when I arrive.

expressions.meaning_en: I will write to you (WhatsApp, email...).
expressions.example: I'll send you a message with the details.

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly goodbye.
expressions.example: See you next week. Take care!

expressions.meaning_en: Goodbye for now.
expressions.example: I have to go now. See you later!

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly goodbye.
expressions.example: Bye-bye, have a nice day!

expressions.meaning_en: Said when you meet someone after a long time.
expressions.example: Ahmed! Long time no see! How are you?

expressions.meaning_en: A question about someone's age.
expressions.example: How old are you? - I'm twenty-two.

expressions.meaning_en: A question about someone's country or city.
expressions.example: Where are you from? - I'm from Jeddah.

expressions.phrase: Can I get the check, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على الفاتورة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for the bill in a restaurant.
expressions.example: We're done, thank you. Can I get the check, please?

expressions.meaning_en: Sometimes, not often.
expressions.example: I visit my grandparents from time to time.

expressions.meaning_en: A soft yes.
expressions.example: Is the meeting at ten? - I think so.

expressions.meaning_en: I have the same opinion.
expressions.example: I agree with you. It's a good plan.

expressions.meaning_en: Never; or surprise: I can't believe it.
expressions.example: You walked ten kilometers? No way!

expressions.meaning_en: Showing surprise or asking if something is true.
expressions.example: He passed all his exams. - Really? That's great!

expressions.meaning_en: Relax, don't worry too much.
expressions.example: Take it easy. We still have time.

expressions.meaning_en: Stop being angry or nervous.
expressions.example: Calm down and tell me what happened.

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly way to ask how someone is.
expressions.example: Hi Sara, how are you doing?

expressions.meaning_en: Said when you meet someone for the first time.
expressions.example: I'm Omar. - Nice to meet you, Omar.

grammar.title: Polite requests: Can you...? / Can I...?
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم Can you + فعل لنطلب من شخص أن يفعل شيئًا، وCan I + فعل لنطلب شيئًا لأنفسنا. نضيف please في البداية أو النهاية لنكون أكثر أدبًا. الفعل بعد can يأتي بصيغته الأصلية دائمًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "Can you + verb" to ask someone to do something, and "Can I + verb" to ask for something for yourself. Add "please" to be polite. The verb after "can" is always the base form.
examples: Can I get the check, please?
Can you say that again, please?

grammar.title: I'll + verb (a quick promise or decision)
grammar.explanation_ar: I'll اختصار I will. نستخدمها عندما نقرر أو نعد بفعل شيء الآن: سأفعل كذا. بعدها فعل في صيغته الأصلية.
grammar.explanation_en: "I'll" is short for "I will". Use it for a promise or a decision made now. Follow it with the base verb.
examples: I'll send you a message tonight.

grammar.title: Asking personal questions: How old...? / Where... from?
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال عن العمر نقول How old are you? والجواب I'm + العمر. للسؤال عن البلد نقول Where are you from? والجواب I'm from + المكان. لاحظ أن الفعل are يأتي قبل you في السؤال.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask age with "How old are you?" (answer: I'm 25). Ask origin with "Where are you from?" (answer: I'm from Egypt). In questions, "are" comes before "you".
examples: How old are you? - I'm thirty.
Where are you from? - I'm from Jordan.
Where is she from? - She's from Oman.

questions.question: What does "Long time no see" mean?
choices: I haven't seen you for a long time.
See you in a long time.
I don't have time to see you.
questions.explanation_ar: Long time no see تعني: لم أرك منذ زمن طويل.
questions.explanation_en: It means we have not met for a long time.

questions.question: You want the bill in an American restaurant. You say: "Can I get the ___, please?"
questions.explanation_ar: في أمريكا تُسمى فاتورة المطعم check.
questions.explanation_en: In American English the restaurant bill is the "check".

questions.question: Your friend is very stressed before an exam. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: Take it easy تعني اهدأ ولا تقلق، مناسبة لشخص متوتر.
questions.explanation_en: "Take it easy" tells someone to relax.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد can يأتي الفعل بصيغته الأصلية: help.
questions.explanation_en: After "can" we use the base verb: help.

questions.question: "From time to time" means:
questions.explanation_ar: From time to time تعني من حين لآخر، أي أحيانًا.

questions.question: Someone in a crowded place is blocking your way. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: Excuse me تُستخدم بأدب لجذب الانتباه أو طلب المرور.
questions.explanation_en: "Excuse me" politely asks someone to let you pass.

questions.question: "How old are you?" - "___"
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن العمر، والجواب I'm + العمر.
questions.explanation_en: It asks about age, so the answer gives an age.

questions.question: Which sentence means "I will send you a phone message"?
questions.explanation_ar: I'll text you = سأرسل لك رسالة (وعد بالمستقبل).
questions.explanation_en: "I'll text you" is a promise about the future.

questions.question: Is the shop open now? - "I think so." This answer means:
questions.explanation_ar: I think so تعني أظن ذلك، أي نعم على الأغلب.
questions.explanation_en: "I think so" is a soft yes.

questions.question: Which is the strongest way to say thank you?
questions.explanation_ar: I really appreciate it تعبير قوي عن الامتنان.
questions.explanation_en: "I really appreciate it" shows strong thanks.
